stem:
A. WITHOUT using any triangle tiles, place 4 tiles so that 1/2 of a square shape is black. Then shade in the square below to show what you did with your tiles.

Shade in Here

[Image: Square grid]

descriptors:
Draws a pattern made up of 2 black tiles and two white tiles. See examples below.
[Image: 2 by 2 grid with the bottom two squares shaded black] [Image: 2 by 2 grid with the top-right and bottom-left squares shaded black]
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: Under the heading "Shade in Here", a large square is divided into a 2 by 2 grid of 4 smaller congruent squares. Each of the 4 smaller squares has dotted diagonal lines connecting opposite corners, dividing each square into 4 congruent triangles.
